translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

content: Gor Ñapan Nuk Mindpun Ak Niŋiy Mindrep Ginjun
Gor chinup wasemb yimb ay ñapan yand aŋgip ak, wal apiyn. Pen biynimb yikop gok, niŋind chinup ma dipay. Bapiy chin ak nup diy rek, chinup dipyap.

Pen buŋgiy tep yand gok niŋim! Miñiy Gor ñapan nuk mindpun ak, kisen key yimb mindoniŋgambun. Yerip rek mindoniŋgambun ak, niŋrep ma gipun ak pen, nuk miseŋ gek nup niŋiy, chin biynimb kun gok key yimb ay, nuk mindip rek ak mindoniŋgambun.
Biynimb gos tep kun ak niŋbay gok, Krays suŋ-tep mindip rek mindenjun aŋgiy, mindrep yimb gipay.
Biynimb tap siy tap timey gipay gok, Gor nup minim ak timbrikpay. Tap siy tap timey ak key mer; mey minim nup timbrikpun ak nep.
Pen chin niŋbun: Jiysis tap siy tap timey gipay rek niŋiy awak. Nuk tap siy tap timey ma gip ak mey;
biynimb nuk gek kim kisenimb rek mindpay gok, tap siy tap timey giyiŋg ma mindeniŋgambay. Biynimb tap siy tap timey gi mindpay gok, nuk bi yerip rek mindip ak ma niŋiy, nup ma chiŋgipay.
Ñapan tep yand gok. Biynimb gunap nimbip nembnemb gi dand kind kiyk okok amniŋgiy rek ayip ak, niŋrep ginimimb. Biynimb mindrep gipay gok, Krays suŋ-tep mindip rek mindpay.

Pen biynimb tap siy tap timey giyiŋg mindpay gok, Seytan bak ayek, nuk tap siy tap timey per gip rek gi mindpay. Ar kun ak nep, Gor Ñinuk apiy, Seytan biynimb gok kuyip timey giyiŋgip miñ ak, timbrikak.
Biynimb Gor ñapan nuk mindpay gok, nuk mindrep gip rek mindiy, tap siy tap timey gok asikrep gipay. Nuk mindip rek mindiy, tap siy tap timey gi mindeniŋgiy rek ma ayip.
Kun ak Gor ker mindpay akaŋ, Seytan ker mindpay ak niŋrep gipun. Biynimb mindrep ma giy, mam ay gok kuyip wasemb ma aypay gok; Gor ñapan nuk ma mindpay.
Mam Ay Gor Ker Mindpay Gok Kuyip Wasemb Aynimimb
Pen nimbip kiñiŋ giy aŋgiy per apun rek: mam ay gok kuyip wasemb aynimimb.
Andam ñinuk Keyn gak rek ma ginjun. Nuk Seytan ker mindiy, numam kisen mindrep gak ak nup, miluk niŋiy, pisnep pikayek kumak.
Kun ak mam ay yand gok. Biynimb yikop gok nimbip niŋey miluk yowniŋgamb ak, gos kuŋay ma niŋnimimb. Ak yikop kun giniŋgambay.
Chin mam ay gok kuyip wasemb aypun rek niŋbun: Gor chinup dek, pisnep kumbay kind ak kirgiy, perper mindeniŋgambay kind ak opun. Biynimb wasemb ma aypay gok, pisnep kumbay kind ak mindnep mindpay.
Biynimb mam ay gunap kuyip miluk niŋbay gok, biynimb chip ñapay gok rek ayip. Pen biynimb chip ñapay gok, yergiy perper mindeniŋgambay.
Krays chinup simb niŋiy kumak rek, chin mam ay gunap kuyip simb niŋiy, monmon direp ginjun.
Biynimb tap kuŋay mindakniŋ, mam ay tap tikdip gok kuyip, simb ma niŋniŋgambay gok, yergiy Bapiy Gor biynimb simb niŋimb rek, gipun aŋgniŋgambay.
Kun ak ñapan yand gok. Minim nep ma aŋgjun, mam ay gok kuyip wasemb yimb ayjun.
Biynimb Gor Nup Chiŋgipay Gok Wisimb Yapiy Nep Mindpay
Kuyip wasemb yimb ay mey, minim yipul yimb direp gipun ak, niŋrep giniŋgambun. Gor windin yirik ar ak chin nambiŋ ma diy, wisimb yapiy nep mindoniŋgambun.
Chin key gos par ayiŋg mindoniŋgambun ak; Gor Biyomb yimb gos timund chinup maŋgiysek niŋrep gip ak niŋek, tep ma yimb giniŋgamb.
Kun ak biynimb yand gok niŋim: aŋgip rek giy mey, gos kuŋay ma niŋiy, Gor windin yirik ar ak ñawil ma diniŋgambun.
Minim aŋgip rek giyiŋg nup aŋgniŋoniŋgambun, tep gakniŋ, aŋgniŋgambun rek giniŋgamb.
Pen chinup aŋgak rek giniŋg, Ñinuk Jiysis Krays nup gosimb niŋiy, mam ay gok kuyip wasemb ayjun.
Biynimb aŋgip rek gipay gok, nuk kiy yip mindek; kiy pen nuk yip mindpay. Kawnan nuk yokek ap chin yip mindpun ak, nuk yip jimñiy mindpun ak niŋbun.
